CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.catalog_quantity_label(p_value text)
 RETURNS text
 LANGUAGE sql
 IMMUTABLE STRICT
 SET search_path TO ''
 SET extra_float_digits TO '1'
AS $function$
  select replace(trim_scale(((p_value::double precision)::text)::numeric)::text,'.',',')
$function$
